find_stations.description: Find the weather stations that report observations, either the ones nearest a latitude and longitude (closest first) or every station across whole states. Each comes back with its ID, name, position, elevation and the zones it sits in. Search one way at a time: by coordinate or by state.

find_text_products.description: Find the text bulletins forecasters write, newest first - area forecast discussions, public information statements, river statements, hurricane advisories and about 340 other kinds. Filter by kind, by the office that issued it, and by time. Each row names a bulletin; 'Read a text bulletin' returns its words.

get_active_alerts.description: Read every watch, warning and advisory in force right now - tornado warnings, winter storm watches, flood advisories, heat advisories and the rest - with the areas each covers, its severity and urgency, when it expires, and the full text and safety instructions. Narrow it one way at a time: to a latitude and longitude, to states, or to zones. Leave the scope empty for the whole country. No alerts in force is an empty list, not an error.

search_alerts.description: Search recent alerts, including ones that have already expired, newest first. Same filters as 'Get active alerts', plus a from and until time. description: Read official US weather straight from the National Weather Service: forecasts by the day and by the hour for any coordinate, current conditions and observation history from its reporting stations, every watch, warning and advisory in force, the zones and local offices behind them, the text bulletins forecasters write, and a glossary that explains the jargon. No account or API key required.
